notes.title: Launch Day Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Exiting Steam Early Access[/h1]

Greetings Kings and Heroes players,

We want to take this opportunity to thank you for your feedback and support throughout Early Access. It’s been about 3 years since we started Kings and Heroes and half of that time, we’ve been in Steam Early Access. Along the way, we have found a lot of great community members that have put in countless hours supporting our development with their time and feedback and we want to express our gratitude as it has been a fun and educational process where we have learned a lot.

We hope you continue to let us know what you like, love and dislike about the game so we can continue to tune it for you, the community. It’s exciting to today announce that Kings and Heroes is exiting Early Access and is now officially launched.

This doesn’t mean we are done working on the game, as Kings and Heroes is a living and breathing online world, and will continue to add content and update the game to support its growth. 

We’re happy to announce the current content roadmap for the upcoming month. Here’s what we are adding first:
•	Heroism System – Adding to allow players who have reached level 50 to specialize their characters even further with added abilities, bonuses and advancements
•	Quest packs – Regular additions of new quest lines and creatures
•	Linux Version
•	Mac Version

We’ll be announcing more content updates as well, but today is a great day to get into the game and start playing. The game is much improved and we hope you have a lot of fun playing there.

As always, please use the Feedback button to update us on any new issues (in the Options Panel in game). We truly appreciate your feedback.

See you in game!

Industry Games

notes.title: Patch 55 – The Beginning of the World!
notes.content:
[h1]Overview[/h1]

This patch is HUGE.  We’ve been working hard for months and we’re very happy to present it for your evaluation.  We’ve worked on way too many things to list them all individually, so here are the main updates in this patch.

[b] Please use the Feedback button to update us on any new issues (in the Options Panel in game)[/b]

[h1]The World[/h1]
This patch begins with population of large sections of the world with content to explore. We intend to deliver additional content over the next week to add more life to the world. The inner areas of the world (grassland/forest) are mostly populated with more being added next week in the remaining grassland and entire tundra areas.

[H1] 3rd Person View[/h1]
After substantial player demand, we are happy to bring you 3rd Person perspective and hope you enjoy it. After testing it extensively over the last few months we feel it’s an amazing feature that we know players will love.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/5652858bc55b98b2d05c71523993754c8e5dbc5f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improved Map & Minimap[/h1]
The world map has been greatly updated (not final) to show a high level of detail to player surroundings. The minimap in world and the dungeons has been implemented. The dungeon minimap is a first pass and will be revised and finalized in a pass early next week.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/9a617a475c35e7ed1b5afb8f1d3e8204d4708c08.jpg[/img]

[h1]Performance[/h1]
Below is an Overview of performance upgrades:

•	Upgrade Engine to Unreal 4.17
•	Optimized Rendering Performance in the world and enabled multiple cascaded shadow maps (shadows will now vary with quality)
•	Fixed multiple player mount bugs
•	Fixed issues with foot surface detection (correcting sound as well)
•	Prioritize asynchronous loading of player armor to smooth loading of characters
•	Added global chat, /g as shortcut. This functions across the entire world.
•	Character stat panels now update your stats more accurately.
•	Improved UI for Player screens, Journal, and NPC interactions
•	NPC interaction text now accurate.

[h1]Player Stats[/h1]
Player stats have been revised and balanced. This should allow for players to have a more even gameplay experience in terms of combat. Prior to this magic damage would be mitigated twice (via armor reduction and magic resistance reduction). In the new system, spells will be reduced via Magic resistance (which is a new stat that provides resistance to all types of magic) and physical damage will be reduced my armor. Armor factor no longer has any effect on magic/spell damage. 

Magic Resistance is a new stat that applies to all magics (some items may still have additional magic resists that would be additive to the base Magic Resistance stat for a specific type of magic). Players should keep in mind that abilities may have more than one damage type that is mitigated by different stats (i.e. Poison Arrow features an initial damage that is physical (armor mitigated) damage, and a damage over time that is Nature (magic resistance) damage).

In addition to this change, player stats will now more align with the classes they play. All player abilities now scale off a classes primary attack power. Melee Attack Power for Champions and Rogues, Spell Power for Wizards and Clerics, and Ranged Attack Power for Rangers. Players will no longer have to worry about a balance of all types of spell powers to affect the output of their abilities.

•	New stats have been added to the game
•	Glancing Blow, Deflection, Magic Resistance, Armor Penetration and Spell Penetration will now appear on items
•	Glancing Blow allows a chance to avoid taking a critical hit from physical damage, the hit is reduced to a normal damage blow
•	Deflection functions like Glancing blow but applies to magic/spell damage
•	Armor Penetration allows for a chance for a physical attack to bypass armor mitigation completely
•	Spell Penetration allows a chance for magical attacks to bypass magic resistance completely.

[h1] Abilities [/h1]
Abilities have largely been refactored to work with the new stats. Some abilities have had their effects increased slightly, some reduced. The overall goal is for a more balanced contribution from the different classes offering a different style of gameplay.

•	Ability Tooltips will now show players what they do at different levels of an ability regarding their specifics output
•	Players can now Parry when they have a weapon equipped (like block)
o	Parry will reduce all damage from an incoming blow if timed correctly.

[h1]The Inn[/h1]
The Everdale Inn has been transformed and will no longer allow players to instantly queue for dungeons. This was a functionality that was largely a stop gap while we were fixing areas of the world to support dungeons being zoned into from portals found from player exploration. Players will need to explore the world to locate the dungeons.

[h1]Maps[/h1]
Players can now find maps after completing dungeons in the world. Upon completion of a dungeon (killing the final boss) all players should receive a “map” for that dungeon. These maps will function like sitting at the Inn. Once a player has a map to a dungeon they can speak with the map merchant in town (Jeran Falstead) and he will function like the old tables at the inn. Only the group leader is required to have a map when interacting with Jeran to allow for instant travel to the dungeon. 

[h1]Gameplay Improvements[/h1]
•	Graveyards have been added to the world allow players to respawn near their location rather than teleport back to Everdale.
•	Multiple Bindstones are present in the world that the player can access or use. Players will gain a new teleport stone for each location and be able to use that teleport stone in your inventory to instantly travel to the Bindstone location in the world. This will function as a means for players to fast travel.
•	New item tags (Quest, Unique, Soulbound (cannot be traded))
•	Adjusted/Improved Player character animations (both 1st and 3rd person)
•	Adjusted/Improved NPC movement (removed stutter and sliding of NPC’s)
•	Added dynamic cloth (fixed bug that cause cloth artifacting)
•	Adjusted timing of Melee combat to feel more impactful (in both 1st and 3rd person perspectives)
•	Implemented Parry animation sets for 1st and 3rd person
•	Harvest nodes for raw materials have been added to the world for ore and herbs.
•	Animals now drop leather.
•	The materials vendor currently only sells thread. Cloth, ore and leather availability will be increased in a patch early next week on NPC’s in the world.
•	NPC’s in the world have only been added to the inner sections of the world (the grassland/forest area). The snow-covered areas of the world will have NPC’s added and patch mid next week.
•	Time of Day has been increased to be approximately 4 hours for a full day/night cycle.

[H1] PvP[/h1]
We made the decision to remove PvP gameplay from the game. As the game was built it largely wasn’t designed with balancing PvP gameplay for players, nor supporting the varied content needed to allow for PvP. We had always intended the game to be a PvE experience and for the time being are focused on finishing and improving that part of the game.

[h1]Quests[/h1]
The initial quests have been added to the game in town. These represent only about 20 quests currently with a couple hundred more being patched in next week.

•	Quest giving NPC’s will now have a green rim shader if they have a quest to offer a character. When a quest has had its requirements met the rim shader will turn yellow for the appropriate turn in NPC.

[H1] Founders Items[/h1]
Founders Items are no longer available for purchase in game. If you have the items you can keep them but will not be able to purchase them in the game now or anytime in the future. We want to thank those that were earlier adopters for their support. 

[h1]What’s remaining for launch?[/h1]
•	A “Heroism” system.  This is an amazing end game system that allows you to specialize your class even further.  This allows for progress well past level 50!
•	Loot system revision (dungeon loot as well as crafting patterns and materials)
These two things are being worked on now and will be added soon!  

[b]Disclaimer[/b]
Keep in mind Kings and Heroes is a massively multiplayer online game and as such we’ve tried hard to create a large, vast, living, breathing world.  Even though we will be launching soon, we intend to add content since it is never truly “finished”. 

Thank you for support…see you in game!

notes.title: PvP Update! - Patch 54

The patch this week adds new PvP content, item changes as well as some fixes to current issues.

[h1] Stats [/h1]

We have begun to balance and adjust player stats. The first adjustment moves armor from a fixed value system to a system where mitigation per point of armor declines as you near the cap. This will be the first of several adjustments to bring mitigation and damage values down to give a more manageable combat experience.

•	Adjusted armor mitigation – Armor Mitigation now follows a curve and should no longer allow players to cap armor. Players near or at the cap currently will see their mitigation reduced by approximately 9%. Lower level players should see minimal change in their mitigation.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/9d628f3cd0c4a68212db59bb8986264532e3f4e4.jpg[/img]

Deep in the frozen wastes of Sundaria reside The Frozen. This race of Goblins has been consumed by ice magic. They fight with a vengeance and use their skills with ice magic to destroy their foes. This is a ten level dungeon for experienced adventurers. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/8bb23e209e47b7d6707412f486de36484ac78323.jpg[/img]

•	Fixes various crashes and compatibility issues
•	Includes increased optimization and performance
•	Unlocked frame rate to allow up to 120 Hz
•	Fixed disconnect & network issues in dungeons

•	Fixed issue with Amarians ranged attacks (Rapid Shot)

The stable master has trained a group of Darkspire wolves as mounts for those in Everdale daring enough to ride one!

Zzyzx also offers players a quest at level 50 to trade in their existing stone for a more powerful one.

[h1] Light Magic! [/h1]

Light magic has been added as an additional elemental magic. Players will begin to see items with Light magic on them soon.

[H1] Combat [/h1]

We are working to improve many aspects of our combat. Our last pass focused on Player centric adjustments. This patch begins adjustments to NPC’s and how they are affected by abilities, in addition to adding a variety of deaths, changes in animation stats (i.e. targets and players seeing different animations for different abilities when hit). This will take several patches to implement and this is the beginning

•	Dispel Magic and Free have had their utility improved. Many abilities/buffs are now dispellable.
•	Added multiple variations of death animations to many NPC’s
•	Added animations when impacted by specific abilities to increase effect (1st person and 3rd person)

[h1]Performance[/h1]

•	Fixed several crash scenarios

[H1] Gameplay[/h1]

•	NPC’s can now grant quests as well as being a merchant, look for more content here in the future
•	Fixed issues with when mounting and dismounting
•	Fixed difficulty settings in dungeons that would sometimes cause NPC’s to spawn with incorrect difficulty
•	Fixed broken boss doors that would not perform correctly
•	Increased randomization of available dungeons
•	Fixed origin on several dungeon sections that would cause NPC’s to stream in slowing (sometimes popping)
•	Improved Amarian NPC Ability sets, Amarian NPC’s will now pull from a larger group of abilities when combating players
•	Smaller NPC’s have had their hit boxes increased, animation changes to make them less jumpy coming soon
•	Many dungeon traps have had their lethality increased, be mindful when crossing them
•	Added several sounds to environment, npcs, traps
•	Boss cards have been improved and updated.
•	Fixed Level of Detail settings on many items to reduce popping
•	Many Icons were updated
•	Fixed issue where alignment was not setting proper selection
•	Players may now purchase more than one scroll of resurrection
•	NPC's in general have had their damage output and experience given reduced. They have also had their health increased. These adjustments were increased with difficulty.



Thanks for checking out our patch notes! We have much more on the way!

John

notes.title: Patch 42
notes.content:
We've revamped Matchmaking to make it easier for players to join others who are creating dungeons.  There are also many other fixes and optimizations in this patch.  This was necessary before we start adding the new dungeons and world content.  The game should now be in a good state for us to move ahead with this.  Thank you all for your patience during these patches.  The following lists more details on the specifics of this patch.

Matchmaking:
•	Players now have the option to enable "Available for dungeon" from their player UI (P) or at one of the tables at the inn, this will make players available for matchmaking to those who create dungeons
•	Players creating a dungeon will start a matchmaking lobby to find those players available for dungeon, matching players with up to a 10 level difference
•	When creating a dungeon players may cancel matchmaking to choose different dungeon options

Abilities: 
•	Resurrection targeting is now more forgiving
•	Wall Run surface angle check adjusted for Rogue ability
•	Abilities targeting friendly units can no longer be cast to NPCs

Fixes:
•	Fix Elf male Ear skin color on low LOD
•	Setup various dungeon structures for an upcoming content update
•	fixed Crafting list that was not updating newly learned recipes
•	Fixed round shield and tower shield moved geometry away from bracer and rotated straps.
•	Reduced the amount of account saving in lobby
•	Fixed possible state bug when leaving matchmaking
•	Fixed script warning during endplay of hud
•	Fixed non-functioning calls to play ui sound
•	Fixed bug causing level range for matchmaking to be ignored
•	Fixed bug with starting dungeon
•	Added LODs to grouped static meshes
•	Cache equipped items in lobby to reduce server calls and improve performance
•	Removed old camera shake/anim notify assets
•	Fixed shield issues in 3rd person, added movement state update; reversed tp bash animations.

- Warren

notes.title: Patch 36 - Caverns of the Wild Patch!
notes.content:
[h1]Caverns of the Wild –Patch Notes[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/020829a7dedc0af7669c2e39290bb9dfb240aee2.jpg[/img]

Hello!

Welcome to patch 36. Probably one of our largest patches to date and the beginning of a flurry of content updates over the coming weeks.Below is a list of notes for this patch.

[h1]The Caverns of the Wild[/h1]

The Caverns of the Wild is a new beginning dungeon experience. An adventure awaits in the Darkspire Mountains. The Darkpire Raiders have long had a secret hideout. Explore the caves to find the hidden entrance to their base. There are many rumors about what the Darkspire are up to. Everything from raiding and pillaging to raising the dead. Adventure to the cave to find out what awaits!

•	The Caverns of the Wild is a new encounter with three entry level bosses for new players.
•	The beginning of the quest implementation starts in the Caverns of the Wild.
 
https://youtu.be/_2ToHl1BDVc 

Massive Environmental Cave Update! A total Environmental revamp for you to explore for hours.



[h1]Natural Cave Environment Set [/h1]

The Caverns of the Wild focuses on a mysterious bandit hideout nestled somewhere in sun-filled caverns, lush with foliage, whereas darker areas are lit with strange glowing butterflies. Small ruins and hints at animal life lay strewn about so take care... the wolves don’t like guests.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/bf210fbf57a203d75e1fef953b10c32a6ca971ec.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Bandit Cave Environment Set[/h1]

Delve deeper into the underground and you may happen upon the secret hideout of the Darkspire Raiders. Much further below, these caves are dry and withered, lit by torches and bonfires, while other areas are dark and haunting. Make sure to bring a light source, you don't know what could be lurking among the scaffolding.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/4a07f04cd0f82d15330923770eefa5010cd0ddad.jpg[/img]

[h1]Wet (Amarian) Cave Environment Set[/h1]

The murky den of the *Amarians Mogfen Liar is unlike any other in Sundaria. Gather close and watch out for the magics of these hostile creatures among the muck. The Lizardmen live in the darkest of areas lit by the mysterious glow of the fungus infested waters which you so lightly follow.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/8c7c079d0205125f710a2d0570062615369c1e6a.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/05384eb2fe3bf6c6a83351bbbcde408403b0c55a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Platforming and Class Movement[/h1]

•	The caves have new platforming assets that greatly improve gameplay. Some of these assets are geared to help players utilize their double jump abilities more. Use the ranger to swing from platform to platform, the rogue to wall run across a chasm, etc.
•	Added several unique areas based on each of the classes' double jump ability. These areas will reward you with loot or hidden chests, but be sure to watch your step!
•	Destructible platforms make some of these areas inaccessible if destroyed. 
•	Ladders have been added to the caves, allowing for tons of platforming possibilities and ladder climbing.
•	Some large rooms now have platform shortcuts that are there for the player to discover and utilize. Most of the time they are hidden away by a destructible wall or in the shadows, so keep an eye out.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/8be905654e12c3288f2f19462866a7a49f038e22.jpg[/img]
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/c2db0e6eddc19f6618059bb90982a7f0013334b1.jpg[/img] 

[h1]Materials[/h1]

•	Enabled ambient occlusion on all mesh materials in the caves to add more depth, contrast and detail.
•	Balanced the diffuse, roughness and specular values to create a more convincing scene with physically based materials. 
•	Updated the look of the water material.
•	Created material instances to achieve a unique look for each of the cave sets.
•	Added detail normal maps to certain materials to bring out more of the gritty look.
 
[h1]Lighting[/h1]

•	Increased post-process ambient occlusion values and scale size.
•	Lighting has become more pocketed to create more contrast around points of interest and lootable objects.
•	Lowered the bloom amount to tone down emissive particles in the caves, including ability particles. 
•	Shifted the colors to a slightly cooler hue to enhance the mood of the caves.
•	Toned down the lens flare to be more subtle.
•	Switched to the Gaussian Blur distance field method to slightly improve performance.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/20637137/abcc20f88fa43f739d52cfeb8f422d51f2ce73a3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

•	Significant improvements to pathing and NavMesh in all cave variants, providing better performance and pathing for the player as well as the AI. 
•	Overall the lighting got darker, light sources are more scarce and have become part of the cave gameplay in form of lootable or interactable objects. Bring a wizard or stock up on torches if you want to search every corner of the cave for loot.
•	Torches can now be looted off the wall and used, lighting the way for any unfortunate adventurer stumbling around in the dark. 
•	Firepits can be interacted with to light large rooms. Look for embers in the darkness! 
•	Decreased the amount of original actors while adding new assets in order to not affect or potentially even improve the current performance in the caves.

[h1]Performance[/h1]

•	Refactor dynamic texture loading of character armor and weapons 
•	Fixes numerous crash scenarios
•	Improved loading performance and memory utilization
•	Added options and feedback menus to lobby
•	Server optimizations for spawning players
•	Server optimizations for destructible objects
•	Server optimizations for number of running and available instances 
•	Better heuristic for preventing overload of game servers
•	Fixed many edge cases that could lead to partially loaded player data, missing ui, abilities, etc.
•	Fix potential cases where players characters could be invisible beyond time taken to load


[h1]Combat[/h1]

There are several combat changes that are in this patch. They are part of a large combat revamp in which we want to make the game combat more immersive. From a player perspective, the combat changes begin with melee weapons. NPC AI changes as well as additional player changes will follow soon.

[h1]Weapon Changes[/h1]

•	All Melee weapons now have their own animation sets
•	Melee weapons will have two types of attacks Directional and Non-Directional
•	Non-Directional attacks will ultimately be faster and less powerful than Directional
•	Directional attacks are activated by pressing a direction just prior to your attack key.
•	Directional attacks have the ability to hit multiple targets
•	
[h1]Additional Combat Changes[/h1]

•	Adjusted melee camera movements.
•	Fixed reticle for classes (champion and rogue has melee reticle while others have ranged one)
•	Adjusted Charge's distance and destination check. 
•	Fixed input stuck issue caused by firewall. 
•	Increased range of Resurrection and Hand of Judgement
•	Hand of Judgement is usable on downed players (not dead)
•	Improved Channel Heal's visual.
•	Added animation for track ability.
•	Adjust hitbox size of lizardman.
•	Fixed animation blend issue
•	Players can now dodge in combat. Pressing shift (Sprint) will move the character backward. If a direction is pressed then dodge, the player will dodge in that direction.

[h1]UI [/h1]

•	Dungeon size option has been removed, all dungeons will be at maximum size.
•	Refactor Dungeon UI to support upcoming themes for each dungeon type
•	Refactor chat UI and expose additional panels for combat and item events
•	Fixed character creation UI issue

[h1]Chat UI[/h1]

The chat UI in the game has been upgraded to allow for multiple chat channels. We have removed the old item pop ups that you used to see on the UI.

•	Improved the overall quality and performance of player chat
•	Loot updates will now show in chat
•	Quantities and qualities of items will show in chat appropriately
•	The first pass of combat log done, will be improved and detail added in future passes

[h1]Items[/h1]

•	Improved Item Tooltip load times
•	Torches in Caverns of the Wild are lootable (most torches will be adjusted to this in the near future)
•	New asynchronous asset loading implementation (armor/weapon/world loot)
•	Item data on inventory page will autoload
•	New Crafted weapon/armor stats calculation (will be implemented in next major patch)

[h1]Quests[/h1]

Quests have been implemented in the game and should begin to increase in frequency

•	Quests can be tracked under the Journal tab
•	Quests once accepted can be Abandoned by clicking the x in the upper right corner of the Quest information on the Journal Tab
•	You can currently track up to 10 quests at a time
•	If an NPC has a quest and players meet the requirements they will be offered the quest upon talking to an NPC
•	NPC’s do not have any external marking to indicate they have a quest.

Thanks for checking out our patch notes! We have much more on the way!

John

notes.title: Patch 22 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch 22 Notes[/b]

This patch is the beginning of several changes coming to the player classes in the game. The goal is to provide a more balanced gameplay experience from each class but not to make all classes the same. We view this as an ongoing process that we anticipate the community to be involved in. Thanks for all the great feedback. Here is a list of the changes included in this patch

[b]Feature & Performance[/b]

•	Dual wield weapon bonus - Dual wielding weapons will now increase attack speed and weapon damage
•	Fixed some items with incorrect icons
•	Fixed issue where you could not use potion when entering/leaving stealth
•	Fixed issue with cloth causing fatal error
•	Fixed issue with NPC movement speed causing them to appear like they are engaging player
•	Attack speed and movement speed on items now correctly adjusts character stats
•	Players with characters stuck in group should have their characters fixed. You should be able to group normally with those characters now.

[b]Class Ability Adjustments[/b]

•	Class ability adjustments are to all levels of the ability unless otherwise specified.

[b]Champion[/b]

The Champion has had the melee responsiveness adjusted to feel quicker with their attacks. Players may have experienced a delay from using one ability to another, that should be greatly reduced or gone. 

•	Bash – Duration for all levels set to 3 seconds (lower ranks increased from 2 seconds)
•	Demonsbane – Damage reduced
•	Cleave - Cooldown and Damage reduced, now generates a large amount of threat on all enemies
•	Charge – Damage amount increased, cooldown at lower levels reduced
•	Mighty Blow – Cooldown and damage reduced
•	Hand of Judgement – Cooldown reduced, stun duration increased at lower levels, reduced at level 5
•	Fist of Judgement – Cooldown reduced, knockback distance reduced
•	Skin of Stone – Damage reduction amounts at levels 3 and 4 reduced slightly

[b]Cleric[/b]

The Cleric has had some adjustments to make their spell combat more effective.

•	Regen – Cooldown increased, heal amount per tick increased 
•	Free – Area effect cone increased to 90 degrees
•	Holy Light – Damage, radius and cooldown increased significantly
•	Blessing of Wisdom – Cooldown reduced, duration increased
•	Smite – Spell damage increased. Smite will be converted into an attack that will function as a spell from distance and a scaled melee attack doing weapon plus ability damage in melee range. This should happen within the next week.
•	Divine Shield – Damage absorb and duration increased, cooldown reduced
•	Resurrection – Revived health amount at Level 5 reduced slightly
•	
[b]Ranger[/b]

•	Explosive Arrow – Damage reduced at Level 5 and Effect radius increased. Ability effect should now scale to size of ability. Explosive arrow Area of Effect damage (AOE) has a falloff now. Targets on the outer perimeter will take less damage than targets near impact.
•	Poison Arrow – Reduced arrow impact slightly at Level 5, increased poison damage across all levels
•	Trap – Increased (doubled) the range at which a player can set a trap
•	Rapid Fire – Reduced the damage done by Rapid Fire to be lower on all shots. Next pass on this ability will increase the damage of the initial shots with the damage of each reducing slightly with each shot.
•	Paralyzing Shot – Cooldown reduced

[b]Rogue[/b]

The Rogue has had the melee responsiveness adjusted to feel quicker with their attacks. Players may have experienced a delay from using one ability to another, that should be greatly reduced or gone. 

•	Eviscerate – Increased damage
•	Stealth – Players will now have a momentary immunity to damage when entering and leaving stealth, movement speed penalty increased slightly. Stealthed players will now be undetectable when standing behind an NPC, when standing in front you have a limited time til they see you (~4 seconds). We intend for this system to be level based where a high level player would have longer to be detected and a lower level would be detected sooner.
•	Blind – Duration increased
•	Hamstring – Cooldown and damage reduced, duration increased
•	Mortal Strike – adjusted animation to attack faster

Patch Notes



Overall

General & Performance
•	Optimized distance-shadowing on meshes to reduce cost of far shadows
•	Fixed several broken and missing LODs

•	Integrated Unreal Engine 4.12 and updated all game runtime libraries
•	Integrated and updated Coherent UI
•	Integrated and updated Simplygon
•	Moved all armor and weapon meshes to be dynamically loaded, resulting in large reductions of memory usage
•	Moved data loading previously done during game launch to first-load when connecting to character selection, resulting in much faster game launching
•	Fixed a crash caused by some cases of asynchronous level loading
•	Fixed a crash caused by some cases of asynchronous character data loading
•	Fixed behavior of graphics options sliders that were not always setting correct values
•	Remove superfluous objects from the network range of players, resulting in less network traffic
•	Overhaul net-code of dungeon objects to fix issues of initially invisible characters, improve loading behavior, resolve crashes and in general improve efficiency
•	Doors now dynamically update navigation; this causes AI to switch back to their previous action if doors are closed when navigating (i.e. closing doors will reset NPC’s)
•	Removed expensive collision causing server load times and latency when multiple physics interactions are occurring
•	Changed Ice Cave level requirement to 15 to prepare for Ice Cave revamp

•	Fixed a dungeon issue that would sometimes cause doors or caps not to spawn creating an opening into space

notes.title: Patch 8 Notes
notes.content:
Hi,

Thanks for joining us, welcome to Patch 8. Patch 8 primarily features many fixes for load crashes and errors as well as a grouping/matchmaking upgrade. Please see the patch notes below for more information.


[b]Load Crashes[/b]

Fixed multiple crashes based upon several load conditions.

[b]Grouping & Matchmaking[/b]

[u]Please Read[/u]

Player grouping and starting a dungeon are now handled separately. The matchmaking and group systems were overhauled to refine matchmaking criteria making grouping much easier. Joining a group can be done in one of two ways.

Players may still approach another player and invite them when the prompt pops up on screen. Players can continue to fill out their groups this way if they wish. The other option will be to access the new Group tab (replacing the old Friends tab). Players may click “Find Group” and they will be placed in the grouping/matchmaking system. The Join card on the dungeon creation menu has been removed. 

The primary criteria looks for players in the level range within +/- 5 levels of the group leader. The goal is to ensure all players receive experience for the dungeon. 

When you have the group of your desired size, the group leader must then go to the inn, sit down at a table and create their dungeon. The dungeon will start immediately upon creation, no need to hit F10. All players in group at the time of dungeon creation will join dungeon, players will not be able to join after dungeon has started.

Fixed additional grouping issues & bugs.

[b]Action Bar/Ability Bar[/b]

Players will notice that action/ability bars were reset, this was necessary to allow for consumables to be placed into the action bar. We do not foresee any future reset to the bar due to this. Consumables are not yet able to be placed; we anticipate this functionality later in the week.

[b]Crafting[/b]

Crafting experience has been adjusted to utilize the crafting experience curve originally intended. Crafting items at your level should grant the most  experience available at any given level. Crafting items below your level should grant less experience. Salvaging experience has been adjusted as well.

Weaponsmithing patterns have had their quality adjusted fixed.

Crafting recipes were not displaying the correct raw material quantities needed in order craft an item.


[b]Animations[/b]

Fixed multiple animations

[b]Abilities[/b]

Fixed issues where players could not purchase abilities from class trainers due to level of ability, this has been fixed.

Cleric, Champion and Wizard classes had their abilities adjusted. 

[b]Items[/b]

Slash, Crush and Resist damage on weapons are now correctly modified. Previously weapons had incorrect stats.

Early Access Items are no longer included in beginning inventory (this was due to be a week only promotion from launch date and was extended)

[b]Sound[/b]

Enhanced several NPC’s interaction with voice, added ambient sounds.


There are many items we continue to work on. If you experience issues with any of the items that have been patched please submit feedback in game or via the support forums on steam. We are continuing to work on items that are access and performance related as our highest priority. Thank you for supporting us!

John

We are working on the performance and grouping issues in the town and will be patching again shortly.  What a tremendous response during just our first few hours of Early Access.  We are overwhelmed by the response to the game and thank you for your patience as we get these issues sorted out.  We feel that with this next patch you will see a significant improvement in the experience. 

Warren

notes.title: First Patch
notes.content:
Happy Launch day!! We are excited to bring King’s and Heroes to you. As with any new endeavor there can be hiccups and with our launch we had some. I wanted to let you know that we have been and always will be in touch with the community and work hard to earn your support. 
The launch today overwhelmed us and brought to light many issues we had not seen with the number of people we had previously tested with. Please know that will read all feedback and are very aware of the frustration you are experiencing. Please see the list of fixes you should be able to see resolved. If you find any that are still outstanding or new ones come to light please use the feedback in game to let us know your issues. You feedback gives us your character information as well as the location when you submit. 

Dungeon Issues
There was an issue with certain dungeon pieces not loading corrections causing the dungeons to break. This would lead to two issues
-	Players would be able to see the world skybox and not proceed
-	NPCs would not navigate, and therefore not be able to attack or be attacked

Interface
Issue with Keybindings – currently we are looking into this, no eta at this time

Grouping
Fixing various grouping issues

Graphics
Screen tearing – Fixed an artifact with the Patron’s Cloak
Dungeon’s are intentionally darker, we are looking at the settings we recommend adding a Wizard to your party to lighten things up. 

Network Performance
Using /tell opens a window but you cannot interact with it

NPC interaction – NPCs had a bug with the Weaponsmith interaction – should be resolved

Issue of stats not going above maximum, maximum is stated in the UI and racial bonuses should be accounted for in result
Unable to leave group

Thank you for all your feedback.

Warren

notes.title: Updated release date – May 31st
notes.content:
We are very close to finishing our first title, but with our release date looming, we realize that there are still a couple of things that need additional work (in particular, some world content and crafting). Because of this we’ve decided to delay the release of Kings and Heroes until May 31st.  This additional month will give us the time to improve these areas and provide a better experience. We feel it’s something special that you’ll want to play for a long time.  Our plan has always been to deliver a great game and use Early Access as a time for testing and refining.  We hope you’ll be understanding of this delay and can bear with us as we improve a couple areas of the game.  I know this additional time will be well worth it when you are able to join us in Everdale.

- Warren
